title: turtle_bringup launch and cmd_vel delivery
tests: colcon build turtle_bringup (empty then with launch)
Ctrl+C stops launch and closes turtlesim
ros2 topic pub --once /turtle1/cmd_vel Twist moves turtle
pub to /cmd_vel: publisher visible, subscription count 0, no motion
pub to /turtle1/cmd_vel: delivery to turtlesim, motion resumes
notes: Correct Twist type is not enough: full topic name must match for delivery. Discovery shows the publisher; delivery needs a matching subscriber.
